svg.text: PROPOSED · VIDEO-V2 seeker · portrait-3button · dark theme · dragging
Target concept, not a capture. Insets/cutout: MEASURED photo/bright/dark/portrait/shown. Base layer: #142 proposed target. Synthetic media.

g.text: frame tile 44.0×56.0 dp, contiguous, span 1100.0 dp [PROPOSED]
frame times t_i = i·(d−100 ms)/N [OBSERVED VIEW:V16]
resolution 1624.24 ms per px of drag [COMPUTED]
2 dp white ring + 1 dp black keyline round the whole video
8 dp #8C9BFF sphere fixed at the playhead, 4 dp above tiles
no label, no centre line, no extra chrome (removal list)
one drag target = whole band 384.0×76.0 dp
video row → band 12.0 dp · band → slab 8.0 dp
gesture exclusion = band (76.0 dp tall ≤ 200 cap)
neighbour items outside the span keep 48×76 tap cells
finger drag moves the span under the playhead;
main view (orange dash) shows the nearest cached frame tile
until a 60 ms pause, then the decoder frame; elapsed text
redraws only when the second changes (VIEW:V17).
font scale 2.0: only the video row grows (#142 F3); band unchanged
